description: This file defines a utility class for creating OpenTracing spans within the Eclipse Hono management API. It provides methods to generate new tracing spans with proper tags for tenant and device identifiers, used for distributed tracing in service operations.

classes.name: Util
classes.description: Utility class for managing OpenTracing span creation in the Eclipse Hono management service.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing span with optional tenant and device tags, inheriting context from an existing span, mainly used for tracing service operations.

methods.name: another newChildSpan
methods.description: Overloaded method to create a new span with only tenant information, calling the main method.
